notes.subject: שולל
notes.rationale: barefoot/captive vs 'spoiled/away as spoil' (KJV); Tok Pisin holim piksa bilong leg — tupela i no gat su.

notes.subject: שולל / יהולל
notes.rationale: Hibru i tanim tok liklik: sholal/holal — narapela tok i sanap klostu, Tok Pisin i no inap holim.

translation: Em i bringim go ol man bilong givim tok, tupela leg ol i no gat ⟨su⟩; na em i mekim ol man bilong kot i kamap nating olgeta.
